standing_rule: Model inputs never change because a sportsbook line or price moves.
roof_rule: For a confirmed closed fixed roof or confirmed closed retractable roof, weather is logged but does not trigger or enter v3. Unknown retractable-roof status fails closed and retains the prior model version.

temperature_2m_f.label: 10F bands, with one lower extreme band

trigger: Inside 48 hours of kickoff, rerun only when an eligible input crosses a locked bin relative to the last validated weather snapshot, or when the first validated inside-48h forecast replaces the preseason median default.
frozen_nonweather_inputs: All nonweather v3 inputs, including the market spread and total used by the original frozen forecast, remain fixed at the model freeze values.
history: Append every validated rerun to an immutable timestamped model-history part; atomically update the current model catalog/feed only after all intended games validate.
personnel_rule: Official injury, inactive, transaction and starter facts are logged with provenance only. They do not change v3 because v3 has no specified and backtested personnel layer.
